description: USE WHEN you revised a portfolio and want to know whether the revision made the tail better or worse. Compares A (reference) with B (candidate) on IDENTICAL simulated paths, so every delta is attributable to the weights, not seed noise. Returns drawdown-distribution deltas, probability-weighted scenario summaries, per-scenario deltas, the risk-concentration shift and which diversification failures B introduces or resolves. revision_required flags a B that deepens the worst-path drawdown or adds a failure. Provide holdings_a and holdings_b as [{asset, weight}]. Descriptive, not advisory; neither portfolio is ranked.

holdings_a.description: Reference portfolio A. Portfolio legs: list of {asset, weight} objects, e.g. [{'asset': 'SPY', 'weight': 0.6}, {'asset': 'TLT', 'weight': 0.4}]. Assets: SPY, TLT, GOLD, BTC (aliases GLD, BTC-USD). Weights are non-negative and normalised to sum to 1; at most 50 legs, no duplicates.
holdings_a.title: Holdings A

holdings_b.description: Candidate revision B, same shape — evaluated on paths identical to A's, so every delta is attributable to the weights.
holdings_b.title: Holdings B

name: portfolio_compare
title: Portfolio compare (paired Revise-step comparison)
